name: Collect host identity
description: Collect the isolated agent identity for lab telemetry.

name: Collect system information
description: Collect kernel information from the isolated target.

name: Collect process list
description: Collect processes visible inside the isolated target.

name: Collect workspace listing
description: List only the explicitly mounted lab workspace.

name: Collect local accounts
description: List local account entries. /etc/passwd holds no secrets; shadow is not readable by the unprivileged agent.

name: Collect container context
description: Determine whether the agent is running inside a container.

name: Collect network interfaces
description: Read interface statistics. In the default lab this shows only loopback, evidencing that the sandbox has no network.

name: Collect installed packages
description: List packages present in the isolated image.
